Condition: Cold plug and slow VBUS droop at every approved source mode with both chargers enabled and one or both packs absent
Acceptance: Measured initial and steady current fit negotiated source and connector including before firmware and after register reset
Evidence_Required: Source contract and VBUS/branch current waveform plus BQ25180 register capture

Condition: Differential pack states through dock insertion/removal and load steps plus watchdog and approved NTC fault injection
Acceptance: Pack and PCM current and temperature limits hold and no uncommanded cross-charge or requirement violation
Evidence_Required: Signed pack/NTC curves with charger current and temperature sweep

Condition: Nominal and maximum expected bridge load on assembled FPC at temperature extremes
Acceptance: Each P2/P3 contact stays at or below min(0.24 A and applicable derated limit) and total drop fits regulator margins
Evidence_Required: Contact-by-contact shunt waveforms and heating with measured harness resistance

Condition: Cold boot and coincident Wi-Fi/BLE/audio burst with lowest approved VSYS and highest expected load
Acceptance: Rail and enable stay inside vendor limits without unintended reset and SWD and host recover after intended reset
Evidence_Required: Probed rail/current transients and boot logs

Condition: LED open/short and monitor out-of-window plus host-state changes and partial-power IO
Acceptance: Electrical faults disable all three rails independently of host and no camera backfeed or frame captured with invalid privacy state
Evidence_Required: Module data and simultaneous fault/rail/LED/stream captures

Condition: Cold start and partial VSYS drop recovery with actual MPNS and load from minimum to maximum
Acceptance: Comply with FPGA-DS-02008 Table 4.2/4.3 and sections 4.5/4.6 including 0.6-10V/ms and applicable 0.5V order
Evidence_Required: Scope acquisition of rails at balls or near-pad Kelvin probes with programmed reset and configuration trace

Condition: Start and restart Y1 at rail/temperature limits with actual input load
Acceptance: Y1 startup within 5ms under datasheet conditions and input levels/loading/recovery meet both vendor contracts

Condition: No panel attached. Inject reset/config failure/first CDONE only/VSYNC loss/static D3/clock loss and short OFF-ON
Acceptance: False startup edges cannot qualify and fault hold times to EN below 0.30V are captured under min/max supplies and temperatures
Evidence_Required: Time-correlated stimuli and TP_AVDD_SAFE 1-7 waveforms with actual probe loading

Condition: Right/left approved equivalent load extremes with abrupt and slow VSYS or 1V8 drop and repeated pre-discharge restart
Acceptance: Demonstrate JBD rail discharge and off-time envelope and exclude IO injection to either eye under complete and partial power removal
Evidence_Required: Signed NDA limits and fixture plus EN/output/load-current traces with per-case deadlines

Condition: Two approved transparent optical engines and adapter continuity plus independent optical metrology
Acceptance: Matching validated FPC pinout and vendor power protocol with independently observed left and right image timing and optical transmission
Evidence_Required: Controlled original vendor pin and protocol data with host traces and optical measurement
